scope: Qualified Enormal Vg=.8/1 V fields, comparing Vela with native, not comparing two Vela initializations.
units: Potentials V; densities and SRH rates cm^-3 and cm^-3 s^-1. Legacy all_row *_m3 headers are internal cm^-3 for this unit-scaling deck; state CSV density columns are SI m^-3.
SRH_meaning: Common positive barycentric Si weights isolate rate/state differences. These charge equivalents are not each solver own source integral, terminal current differences, or source-to-drain transfer predictions.
acceptance: Descriptive field metrics; no new acceptance threshold. The SRH formula is checked against the production integrated source before use.
